paragraphs: Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov, the well-known Tanna.
Rabbi Yehudah bar Yaakov—Tosefta Oholot, chapter 18.
Rabbi Yose bar Yaakov—Zohar, Idra Zuta, Haazinu.
Rav Menashya bar Yaakov—Menachot 32a. Rav Nachman bar Yaakov, the well-known sage.

notes.text: The list includes different sages with the patronymic Yaakov. The checked passages spell Rabbi Abba, Rav Acha and Rav Shmuel explicitly; the abbreviated titles are expanded according to each cited context.
